attr.title: Sir Questionnaire
attr.desc: Explore a dungeon through pairs of choices, collect equipment and learn how to defeat its creatures.
attr.inst: Install SirQuestionnaire.zip, then copy your owned SirQuestionnaire.jar into the installed sirquestionnaire folder. See sirquestionnaire.md for supported files and installation steps. Requires compatible 64-bit ARM firmware and PortMaster Java 17 and Westonpack runtimes.
